scope: Strict CPU float64 scalar literals/default float, ordinary functions, typed native entries, structured local worker captures/results and recovery. No float64 tensor or GPU arithmetic enabled.

semantics.literals: Parse directly into IEEE binary64 with APFloat nearest-ties-to-even; reject finite overflow with S015 before publishing artifacts; gradual underflow may produce zero. Decimal/exponent literals default to float64, whole-number literals remain int64. Unconstrained pure-literal arithmetic with any decimal/exponent literal chooses float64 without operand-order dependence. Already typed values retain strict width/family identity.
semantics.arithmetic: Qualified shared strict binary64 integer MLIR lowering for +,-,*,/, unary signs; every operation rounds separately, including worker kernels. Source rounding, signed zero, subnormals, infinities and NaNs are independent of the tested FPCR controls. IEEE floating /0 does not become an Arithmetic fault.
semantics.entries: Dedicated _mlir_ciface_kalandra_float64_entry returns double; CLI prints 17 significant digits. Native test wrappers accept/return double. Existing float32/integer entries retain their ABI.
semantics.tasks: Float64 continuation literals and numeric kernels, distinct scalar.float64 result/capture layout, private identity 0x20000+NumericType::Float64. All six implemented scalar families coexist without payload width/alignment conflation. Nested/cached awaits, owned-parent-data fault recovery and post-core/invocation scalar values retain exact bits.
semantics.memory: Existing scheduler, numeric storage, checked invocation ABI, retention and Metal implementation reused unchanged. Task-core allocation sweeps, root cancellation/deadline/admission and same-sized result-layout impostors leave no live scheduler/destination allocation state.
semantics.gates: Float64 tensors rejected in source and at backend typed-IR admission on declared results, symbols and expressions. Explicit numeric conversions, floating remainder and float64 Metal modules remain unsupported. Native distributed execution unchanged.

qualification.reference: Shared Float64Oracle.h corpus and LLVM APFloat IEEEdouble, with canonical arithmetic NaN and exact unary sign-bit/payload checks.
qualification.worker_values: Signed zero, minimum subnormal, greater-than-float32 precision, maximum finite, infinity, NaN, multiply/add fusion-sensitive and reassociation-sensitive expressions; nested production/capture/alias/repeated observation.
qualification.host_controls: All four ARM rounding modes, flush-to-zero/default-NaN disabled/enabled; verify installed FPCR and no floating exception flags, restore prior FPCR/FPSR.
qualification.failure_checks: Known integer Arithmetic fault recovered to a captured binary64 value, fresh subsequent task group; repeated exact observation rejects float32/int64/uint64 identity impostors transactionally; task-core allocation positions 1..24 at 1/2/4 workers; cancellation, deadlines, admission rejection and scheduler/allocation settlement.
qualification.frontend: Literal ties-to-even, above-2^53 contextual rounding, max finite/minimum normal/minimum subnormal, default inference and alias, finite-literal overflow, strict typed mixing, tensor/GPU gates and forged tensor metadata. Debug backend and independent ASan/UBSan frontend builds.

cpu_only_build.smoke: Ordinary binary64 arithmetic invoked through a structured worker, using the compiler built with Metal disabled.

performance: Not measured. Binary64 integer lowering qualifies correctness, not a hardware-double speed claim. Host sanitizers do not instrument Metal shaders.
next: CPU float64 tensor literals and elementwise arithmetic; reductions/matmul and explicit conversions require subsequent qualification. Discuss native distributed execution before implementing it.
